title: Introducing Claude for Manufacturing
summary: Claude for Manufacturing is a plugin with 17 skills and four connectors (Autodesk Fusion, Infor, Microsoft 365, and Oracle NetSuite) that drafts quotes, quality reports, and supplier requests, with multi-step skills pausing for human review. Infor is releasing its own plugin so Claude can act in Infor, such as releasing POs, per user permissions and with approval. It targets manual data entry, which 79% of manufacturers report per a 2025 MLC survey, and is available on Team and Enterprise plans.

title: More ways to work with Claude: Sheets, Whiteboards, and Interactive Connectors
summary: Claude is expanding into everyday knowledge work with new artifact types, including Claude Sheets (collaborative spreadsheets), Claude Whiteboards, and Claude Data (formerly Dashboards), plus upgraded Interactive connectors. Claude Meetings is coming soon and Claude auto-connect is in beta for eligible Team and Enterprise plans, with enterprise admins controlling which products and connectors each person uses. Advantage Solutions' FP&A team cut forecast assembly from about 10 hours to under 30 minutes.

title: The Claude Tag guide for startups
summary: This guide, based on interviews with eight high-growth startups using Claude Tag (beta), which lets teams @Claude in Slack channels, covers uses such as on-call alert triage, draft PRs from Slack threads, and scheduled reports. Campfire went from Slack mention to open PR in 21 minutes, and Moritz cut a daily update from about an hour to 5 minutes, with Claude never merging changes itself. It recommends starting with one channel and one task, a small private pilot, limited connector access, and spend limits, and requires a Team or Enterprise plan.

title: Building always-on agents
summary: This guide covers always-on agents that are stateful, proactive, manage context across sessions, and act without direct supervision, mostly sleeping and waking for brief runs using five primitives: event inbox, timers, memory, permissions, and outbox. It argues this is practical now due to better model judgment and lower long-horizon costs, with Opus 5.5 costing 78% less per solved task than Opus 5 on one coding benchmark. Guidance includes treating the inbox as source of truth, running one active worker per inbox, keeping credentials outside the agent behind a proxy, and starting with a quiet agent that earns more attention over time.

title: J. Crew brings its signature approach to styling to life with Claude
summary: J.Crew's Style Advisor, an AI stylist on JCrew.com, is now live for U.S. women's and men's styles and helps shoppers buy complete outfits. Shoppers can describe an occasion or start from one item and receive full looks drawn from J.Crew photo shoots, refinable by chat. Built with Claude Code, it uses a frontier model for planning, Sonnet for styling decisions, and Haiku for quick tasks to bring in-store styling expertise online.

title: Introducing Claude Meetings
summary: Claude Meetings is in beta and lets Claude join Google Meet video calls as a visible participant that follows the conversation and answers questions aloud or in chat. With permission, it can use tools and build docs or whiteboards live, and it writes notes and action items to a claude.ai page with the transcript and artifacts. It is available on Team and Enterprise plans, stays out of calls with outside guests unless an admin allows it, and excludes ZDR, HIPAA-ready, and customer-managed key orgs during beta.
